title: Technology Sector Update for 12/11/2018: SEAC, CAMP, LPTH, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.77%
AAPL: +1.26%
IBM: +1.30%
CSCO: +1.86%
GOOG: +1.77%
Technology stocks were climbing in Tuesday's pre-bell trading.
Moving stocks include:
(-) SeaChange International ( SEAC ), which was sinking by more than 24% a day after the software company guided for downbeat revenue for its current fiscal quarter.
(-) CalAmp ( CAMP ) was down by more than 11% after it authorized a new share buyback program of $20 million.
In other sector news:
(+) LightPath Technologies ( LPTH ) up by more than 2% as it won a supply contact valued at $5.9 million for a variety of infrared optical lens elements to a major commercial infrared vision products customer.
